# docs — Project Documentation

**Belongs here:** Architecture diagrams, decision records, API contract, tenancy rules, runbook.
**Must NOT go here:** Code, secrets, or auto-generated files.

| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `architecture.md` | System diagrams (ingestion + query pipelines) |
| `DECISIONS.md` | One-line record of every architectural default |
| `api-contract.md` | REST API specification (headings scaffold) |
| `tenancy-and-privacy.md` | Data isolation rules and required security tests |
| `runbook.md` | How to start services, run tests, migrate DB |
